verification.note: migrated from data/antibiogram-raw.json: extracted from the source PDF, then re-verified cell by cell by a second reader (2026)

notes: Source: Muthusamy R, Mahesh S, Travasso C. 'Antibiotic Profiling of E. coli Borne UTI Infection in Tertiary Healthcare Settings.' Cureus 16(3):e56632, 2024 (Saveetha Medical College, Chennai). Text extracted with PyMuPDF (6 pages, digital text, fully readable). Study: 80 urine samples from female patients (35-50 yr), 44 UTI-positive, 18 E. coli-positive. ONLY quantitative AST is Table 1 (page 3): zone-of-inhibition in mm for FOUR individual E. coli strains (1B2602, 1B2453, 1B2695, 1R578) with legend '* Sensitive, -- Resistant' (bare numbers without asterisk are ambiguous/not flagged sensitive). This is NOT a percentage-susceptible antibiogram: no %S or %R is printed for any drug across the 18 isolates, and per-drug denominators are only 1-4 strains with inconsistent/partial testing. I therefore did NOT compute or emit any numeric s values (would require fabricating a population statistic from n<=4). All s set null; q captures the printed per-strain qualitative verdict where clear. Methods section names only nitrofurantoin/cephalosporin/cephalexin discs (contradicting the wider drug list in Table 1) and states high resistance to these three, but gives no numeric value. Study is low

notes.cefepime: Per-strain zone-of-inhibition table only (n=4 isolates). 1R578 flagged sensitive (23 mm*). No population %S printed.
notes.ciprofloxacin: Per-strain: 1B2695 sensitive (20*), 1B2602 resistant, 1B2453 19 mm (no asterisk). ~1 of 3 tested strains sensitive; no population %S printed.
notes.gentamicin: Per-strain: 1B2453 sensitive (27*); 1B2602 (13), 1B2695 (10) not flagged sensitive. ~1 of 3; no population %S printed.
notes.cotrimoxazole: Per-strain: 1B2453 and 1B2695 resistant; no strain flagged sensitive. No population %S printed.
notes.cefoxitin: Per-strain: 1B2695 sensitive (21*); 1B2602, 1B2453, 1R578 not flagged sensitive. ~1 of 4; no population %S printed.
notes.ceftriaxone: Only 1R578 tested (20 mm, not flagged sensitive). No population %S printed.
notes.meropenem: Only 1R578 tested (19 mm, not flagged sensitive). No population %S printed.
notes.amikacin: Only 1R578 tested (20 mm, not flagged sensitive). No population %S printed.
notes.ampicillin: Only 1R578 tested; text states 1R578 resistant to ampicillin (7 mm). No population %S printed.
notes.nitrofurantoin: Abstract/discussion state high resistance to nitrofurantoin, cephalosporin, cephalexin, but no numeric %S/%R or count is printed for these methods-listed discs.
